With which of the following techniques were the native navigators of the Pacific NOT
familiar?
questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - magnetic orientation to the poles

questions.stem_text:
The possibility that Homo erectus possessed an aesthetic sense and may have created "art"
is suggested by:

options.A: the discovery of figurines made from clay at the Trinil site.
options.B: recovery of a shell at the Trinil site with an intentionally engraved series of lines.
options.C: the use of complex tools requiring a high level of cognitive function.
options.D: cave paintings and elaborate burials with numerous grave goods at the Trinil site.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - recovery of a shell at the Trinil site with an intentionally engraved series of lines.

questions.stem_text: The "Lion Man" from Hohlenstein-Stadel cave is an example of:

options.B: long-distance trade of exotic raw materials.

questions.stem_text: Which continent features the earliest evidence of etching into a rock face?

options.A: was a simple form of writing with one symbol representing one word

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - appears to have developed suddenly
